_comment: Offline play. The content browser is pinned to the local board served over loopback and can reach nothing else -- not the chess sites, not the wider internet. See docs/adr/0009.
_why_default_deny: This is one half of a two-way default-deny. The online policies allowlist only their chess origin, so the offline board's URL is blocked during online play; this policy allowlists only loopback, so the chess sites are blocked during offline play. Neither mode can reach the other's pages even if something went wrong with the process slot.
